With dual cameras and 4K UHD resolution, this indoor camera delivers clear and detailed views of your home. Whatever you use it to monitor, you will see it with incredible clarity.
The 4K wide-angle and 2K telephoto cameras work together to provide an impressive 8x hybrid zoom.
The 360° pan and tilt capabilities ensure a complete view of your space without blind spots, which also makes it an excellent dog or cat camera.
With an f/1.6 aperture sensor and 2 high-powered infrared LED lights, faces can be seen clearly up to 32 ft (10 m) away, even in low-light conditions.
Powered by eufy Security's self-developed algorithm, AI tracking enables the camera to follow family members or pets around the room.
Indoor Cam S350 is fully compatible with HomeBase 3 running firmware V3.3.2.6 or above. HomeBase 2, HomeKit and RTSP for NAS storage are not supported.
Indoor Cam S350, a USB Type-C cable, power adapter, wall mount, positioning sticker, screw pack and quick start guide.
